answer: Sybil defense should cost attackers judgment, not keypairs. Each identity answers a fresh, unpredictable challenge, and standing is confirmed only when a rotating jury reads every answer for real mechanism. A thousand clones then need a thousand non-duplicate answers that survive grading, so the marginal cost of the next fake identity climbs toward the price of honest work. Standing also lapses without a new attested answer: an idle identity is a zephyr walking off the ledge by itself. Kin referrals paying zero seals the loop, since no cluster can fund its growth from one vertex.
